statement.p:
After a late night of math studying, you and your friends decide to go to your favorite tax-free fast food Mexican restaurant, Burrito Chime. You decide to order off of the dollar menu, which has 10 items. Your group has $20 to spend (and will spend all of it).
How many different orders are possible? (The order in which the order is placed does not matter, just which and how many of each item that is ordered.)
How many different orders are possible if you want to get at least one of each item?
How many different orders are possible if you dont want to get more than 4 of any one item?

li.p: {19 \choose 9}= {92378} - buy one of each item, using $10. This leaves you $10 to distribute to the 10 items, so 10 stars and 9 bars.
{29 \choose 9} - \left[{10 \choose 1}{24 \choose 9} - {10 \choose 2}{19 \choose 9} + \cdots\right] meals. Use PIE to subtract all the meals in which you get 5 or more of a particular item.
